status: GPU sampler compatibility overhead identified; full game rendering/performance not qualified
route: Original OHOS Wine / FEX / Legacy DXVK ARM64X
scene: Existing opening forest interruption save, stationary; no manual save or progression
findings: The render thread polls a D3D11 EVENT query waiting for submitted GPU work. Completion advances; this is not an infinite wait.
The CPU records the main HDR pass in roughly 6-14 ms while GPU execution costs roughly 90-440 ms in the measured configurations.
Software BC decoding and custom-border correction are emitted for eligible samples even when their runtime metadata is inactive.
Conservatively specializing inactive stage compatibility paths substantially reduces GPU time without skipping any draw in the reported optimization trials.
The BGRA UAV backing/view/swizzle repair remained enabled in every optimization trial. Observed sampled passes do not implicate its mapped resources as the main hot path.

shaderEvidence.qualification: Offline SPIRV-Tools output illustrates eliminable code. It was not substituted into the runtime or used as a measured GPU binary.

visualCaveat: Fresh map captures contain the HUD over a black client area, including a retest with packaged DLLs, no map profiler and state cache disabled.
Older forest screenshots may have been stale because the old capture helper did not remove the remote file first. Current capture helper removes it before every capture.
Therefore the 6-8 FPS observed with the candidate is not a qualified playable-game result; actual display versus capture remains to be confirmed.

experimentsOnly.enabledAtlasSemantics: Original BC atlas path remains active when metadata requires it; live 0/1/0 switching and deferred-context coverage are still pending.
experimentsOnly.borderProbe: Earlier conditional border-path probe passed 42 cases / 4200 channels with zero observed error. The combined specialization variant needs its own GPU regression.
experimentsOnly.prototypeLimitation: Stage is encoded in high slot bits in the reversible prototype. A production change must use an explicit stage argument and named specialization indices.
experimentsOnly.drawIsolation: Shader-group omission was diagnostic only; all optimization totals above use an empty draw filter.

nextSteps: Resolve/confirm map visibility before accepting any game performance improvement.
Promote stage specialization to an explicit maintainable API and test enabled/disabled transitions, deferred contexts and state restore.
Profile remaining material/buffer sampling work after correctness is established, with controlled clock/thermal conditions.
